page.layout: One page of text, single column; woodcut headpiece at top; large decorated initial S at left of the opening verse; page number top right; catchword "A" at lower centre-right. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: EMBLEMATA ET EPIGRAMMATA MISCELLANEA SELECTA EX STROMATIS peripateticis ANTONII FAYI.
Deo O. M.
main_text.p: SOLUS ego non sum, dum solus obambulo: mecum Es, Deus: & tecum, sim licet umbra, loquor.
Verba loquor, linguâ nil expromente: sed aures Pectore non tepido sollicitante tuas.
Verba loquor, nullis hominum vulganda: satisque est Dicta fuisse mihi, nota fuisse tibi.
Ne tamen haec studio iactata putentur inani, (Ut mos illorum quos fera bilis agit) Sunt breuibus quaedam chartis commissa: negauit Charus amicorum quas sepelire chorus.
Omne ferent punctum; non si meruisse ferantur Humanos plausus: sed placuisse tibi.
main_text.head: Lectori pio.
main_text.p: Haec pede stans uno non lusi carmina, ceu quos Vberis ingenij vena beata rigat.
Sed fessum releuo corpus dum forsan eundo, Mens spatiis pariter gaudet Apollineis.
Hac totum soleo sic me oblectare palaestra:

page.notes: Woodcut headpiece and decorated initial are ornaments, not transcribed. Underlining and ink marks on the first verses are manuscript/stains and were not transcribed. Ornamental "E" at the title line is part of the title. Some words in the opening verse are partly obscured by the decorative initial; the reading "SOLUS" and "Verba" in the second couplet are as best read.
